confirmed_findings.claim: The CheckPolicy self-management gate is fully bypassable: when base resolution fails, the fatal-vs-free decision uses policy.Mode from the untrusted working-tree file, so an agent can set mode=free plus an unresolvable base_ref in acdsl/policy.json and change any protected rule with zero diagnostics, verified by a runnable exploit test.
confirmed_findings.fix: Never let policy.Mode from the working tree be the sole gate for a failed base resolution: either always hard-fail when the default candidate chain (not a possibly-forged custom base_ref) cannot resolve regardless of local mode, or when policy.BaseRef is set first cross-check the default candidate chain and only report free/bootstrapping when no candidate resolves.

confirmed_findings.claim: Commit 5c11486 removes the Edit/Write permissions.ask entries for ACDSL rule files globally — a removal not called for by the acdsl-policy-modes plan — leaving gated/strict target repos with no human-in-the-loop step between an agent and a rule-file edit, given the fail-open hook and the bypassable checker.
confirmed_findings.fix: Confirm the removal was intentional and, if so, document it in the plan's Changelog per RULE-PLAN-049 rather than leaving it as an unreviewed side effect.

confirmed_findings.claim: GitRevParse is dead production code — nothing in policy.go calls it (policyBase/basePolicy use GitMergeBase/GitShowFile directly) and it is exercised only by its own test.
confirmed_findings.fix: Wire it in where the plan intended it or drop it, per ACTION-IMPL-ARCH-001.

confirmed_findings.claim: The Bash cat post-invocation guard is trivially defeated by quoting — any command containing a double or single quote is excluded from inspection entirely, so cat "context/rules/go.md" bypasses the guard that the unquoted form would trip, giving narrower coverage than the file's comment implies.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add at minimum a one-line comment noting the quoting gap.

confirmed_findings.claim: Type-block order violates RULE-GOLANG-FILE-001: statusEntry is declared before statusCache although statusCache sorts first alphabetically.
writePolicy aborts Dist entirely when LoadPolicy returns a non-ErrNotExist error (e.g. malformed JSON mid-edit), which may surface as an unrelated-looking dist failure.
confirmed_findings.fix: Confirm Dist callers (the smine dist CLI path) surface this error clearly rather than as an unrelated dist failure.

confirmed_findings.claim: RunResult.IsRunning/History started-row filtering is only asserted implicitly through downstream template behavior — there is no dedicated multi-row started-supersession unit test pinning the "only the newest survives" contract.
confirmed_findings.fix: Add a direct unit test for History with an interleaved started/finished/started sequence.
